property_summary: For any non-empty `_tos` array, C.transfer always returns true (does not revert) when the callee returns success for each invoked transferFrom call; the mutant inverts the require on the callee success and will revert when the callee call succeeds for some inputs, so there exist inputs (a non-empty `_tos` and a callee that returns success) that make the mutant fail while the reference always succeeds.
change_summary: Invert the require on the call result to require(!_s) so that the function reverts when the external call succeeds and continues when it fails, changing return outcomes for calls where the callee returns success.
